bigIdea: Read a paper in three passes, each with a question, and you understand it in an hour, not an evening.

beats.name: Orientation
beats.claim: Nobody reads a paper front to back.

beats.name: Foundations
beats.claim: Each part of a paper answers one question, and you read it in three passes.

beats.name: Application
beats.claim: Read the figures first, then try it on a real paper.

beats.name: Mastery
beats.claim: Skim many papers, read few, and ask three questions of any result.

beats.name: Assessment
beats.claim: You can now tell which part of a paper answers which question.

beats.name: Transfer
beats.claim: Read Thursday's paper in two passes.
